pages.title: Altiplano
pages.extract: The Altiplano stretches across more than one country:

pages.title: Central Mozambique
pages.extract: Central Mozambique is a region in Mozambique comprising the provinces of Manica, Sofala, Tete and Zambezia province.

pages.title: Fedje
pages.extract: Fedje is an island off the coast of West Norway. It's in an unsheltered position, far from the mainland or other islands, so it has a rough, coastal climate, with mild winters and cool summers. Fedje is also the name of the archipelago of over a hundred islands that surrounds the main island, and the name of the municipality that administers the islands.

pages.title: George Town (Malaysia)
pages.description: capital city of the Malaysian state of Penang

pages.title: Haiphong
pages.extract: Hải Phòng is Vietnam's third largest city, a port near Hanoi.

pages.extract: There's more than one place called Hart:

pages.title: Katoomba
pages.description: town in New South Wales, Australia
pages.extract: Katoomba is the largest and best-known town in the Blue Mountains. It serves as the main base for travellers to the Blue Mountains, and the main gateway to the two most popular tourist spots at Echo Point and Scenic World.  It has the most shops with all the supplies you need, tourist offices, motels, transport restaurants and even some nightlife.  However, it has lost the quaint village charm to Leura, its immediately adjacent neighbour to the east.

pages.title: Marsaxlokk
pages.description: village and port at the south of Malta
pages.extract: Marsaxlokk is in the south-east part of Malta.

pages.title: Midwest City
pages.description: city in Oklahoma County, Oklahoma, United States

pages.title: North Algona Wilberforce
pages.description: township municipality in Renfew County, Ontario, Canada
pages.extract: North Algona Wilberforce is a township in Renfrew County. It has about 3,000 residents (2021). In the wintertime, North Algona Wilberforce attracts many snowmobilers, cross county skiers and ice fishers. In the summer time it turns into cottage country with many lakes for canoeing, kayaking and fishing. It is a great point to launch out and take day trips out to white water rafting, explore the Bonnechere caves or visit Algonquin Park. Some of the main communities are Deacon, Golden Lake and Rankin.

pages.title: North Central Province
pages.extract: North Central is the largest province in Sri Lanka. Tourists come here to visit two of Sri Lanka's five ancient cities: Anuradhapura and Polonnaruwa.

pages.title: Riquewihr
pages.extract: Riquewihr is one of the most enchanting towns in Alsace. Riquewihr is a medieval city with a lot of half-timbered houses, which give the charm of the city. It is first of all a wine town surrounded by hills of vines. There are many quaint restaurants and Winstube along the main road up the hill. Good shopping in the crystal shops as well. There are old houses from the 16th and 17th centuries. Many still have wells and fountains, and their courtyards are overlooked by galleries above.

pages.title: Stephenville (Texas)
pages.description: city in and the county seat of Erath County, Texas, United States
pages.extract: Stephenville is a city in the Cross Timbers region of Texas. Acclaimed "Cowboy Capital of the World" (okay, maybe there's more than one), it's the home to Tarleton State University, part of the Texas A&M system, and even has an equine therapy program.

pages.title: Taranto (province)
pages.extract: Taranto is a province in Apulia in Italy on the Ionian Sea. The western coast is almost entirely sandy, with important dune systems that can reach up to 15 metres. In the hinterland there is a vast pine forest of great natural value.

pages.title: Łukta
pages.extract: Łukta is a village in the region of Warmia-Masuria, in northern Poland. It is the seat of an administrative district.

pages.title: Jauja
pages.extract: Jauja, (Sausa, Xauxa) is in Southern Sierra (Peru). It is at an altitude of 3,400 m (11,200 ft). Its population in 2015 was about 15,000 people. The town, with a laid-back ambiance and salubrious climate, has narrow streets with houses painted blue. Although visited by few tourists, the town has several significant ruins and attractions, more than Huancayo (which also has few tourists). Laguna de Paca lake is close to the city.

pages.title: Törökszentmiklós
pages.extract: Törökszentmiklós (formerly Zenthmyclos, Balaszentmiklós) is a town of 20,000 people, (2018), and a district in Jász-Nagykun-Szolnok County.

pages.title: Puerto Aventuras
pages.description: town in Playa del Carmen Municipality, State of Quintana Roo, Mexico
pages.extract:
Puerto Aventuras is a coastal resort area in Quintana Roo on Mexico's Yucatan Peninsula. It began life in the late 1990s as developers built luxury beach resorts and golf courses in an area 20 km south of Playa del Carmen. As the resorts were built on the oceanfront property on one side of Highway 307, a local community to support the resorts and tourism industry evolved  on the inland side of the highway.

Miles of powdery white sand beaches meet the crystal clear turquoise waters of the Caribbean sea along the entire Puerto Aventura coast. Resorts offer a range of recreational activities including: golf, swimming, tennis, deep sea fishing, snorkeling, and scuba diving. Tours are available to Mayan sites in the region, natural attractions like cenotes, and nearby beach cities like Playa del Carmen and Cancun.
